A Very Hot Weather Warning remained in effect amid high humidity, while afternoon thunderstorms and a brief hail alert did not prevent the midday maximum. Only a significant downward revision in official data or an unrecognized measurement error could alter resolution, though historical observatory protocols make such shifts unlikely.
